children: The FDA agreed to Annovis Bio’s plan to pool buntanetap safety data from Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s studies for a planned NDA. The pooled analysis is expected to cover three randomized, placebo-controlled studies and one open-label extension; over 1,600 participants are anticipated by DUET-AD’s 6-month readout.
FDA agreed to pool AD and PD safety data
Supports a combined safety package for the planned NDA, but does not establish efficacy or approval.
Pool includes 3 controlled studies and 1 OLE
The analysis draws on multiple trials; the release provides no completed pooled safety results.
Over 1,600 participants anticipated by DUET-AD readout
This is an expected participant count, not a reported completed enrollment or safety finding.
NDA submission intended after DUET-AD data readout
The filing remains dependent on the upcoming readout; no submission date is provided.

This is a regulatory-planning milestone in Annovis Bio’s ongoing Phase 3 development program, not a clinical efficacy or safety result. A DUET-AD readout showing supportive efficacy and safety, followed by NDA submission and FDA review, would be needed for a larger catalyst.
from Annovis Bio, Inc. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
